nodes.klein: to mix. he mixed, mingled; he made an ‘erub’, included within the ‘erub’ (see עֵרוּב). was mixed, was mingled; was included within the ‘erub’. he mingled (with), intermingled; he had fellowship (with); he intermeddled (with). (see עִרְבֵּב).
